trust_decision.summary: Decryption must reject ciphertext whose embedded HMAC does not match the key; the decision is a plain string-identity compare of the packet-supplied digest against hash_hmac(algo, padded, key) inside Crypt::decrypt, which returns early on the first differing byte and leaks the valid digest to a timing attacker.

landing_point.why: The report names Encryption\Crypt::decrypt and the HMAC check; the only digest comparison in the class is this `!==` against hash_hmac() on line 269.
